name: Yoki Koto Kiku
source:
The question of you being here. Of whom I'm standing here for.
The protagonist, Ajirogi Juuzou, returns to his hometown to become a teacher.

"Hey, why not become a teacher in Tayama?"

As someone who dislikes children, I was confronted with an unexpectedly difficult task.
The Tayamaou Forest Academy is a world deep in the mountains, rich in nature.
There, Juuzou met three children.

Minakata Kumagusu. Nenkin. Hakubu Tsugaku.

Looking up at the night sky, he wonders, "Why am I still living here?"
I don't know who or what I am.

This is a work of speculative fiction that takes place in a school on top of a mountain.

[Translated from official website]
